CULLING audit 2026-09-27 (observed Oblivion behavior): Builds six NiPlane records from NiFrustum and NiTransform. Observed order: 0 near, 1 far, 2 left, 3 right, 4 top, 5 bottom. Camera rotation column 0 is forward, column 2 is horizontal side, column 1 vertical. Handles orthographic and perspective branches. ActivePlanes is set separately by 0x70E040.

Culling decode: camera transform column 0 builds near/far, column 1 builds top/bottom, column 2 builds left/right planes; use column 2 XY as view-horizontal cell axis.
GPU culling parity: retains raw camera axes; does not normalize final planes. Near/far offset products and points are stored as float; side slope square, sqrt and reciprocal also have explicit float stores. Plane constants remain world-space dot(normal,point). NiTransform scale is not used.
